issue_context.title: CREATE partitioned table fails check for unsigned int column definition
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
```
create table t (id tinyint unsigned, idpart tinyint, i varchar(255)) partition by range (idpart) (partition p1 values less than (-1));
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
```
mysql> create table t (id tinyint unsigned, idpart tinyint, i varchar(255)) partition by range (idpart) (partition p1 values less than (-1));
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0,03 sec)
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
```
tidb> create table t (id tinyint unsigned, idpart tinyint, i varchar(255)) partition by range (idpart) (partition p1 values less than (-1));
ERROR 1563 (HY000): Partition constant is out of partition function domain
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
```
tidb_version(): Release Version: v6.2.0-alpha-230-g47a4f3a017
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: 47a4f3a017768dda0b9a826451486c5539bc8427
Git Branch: master
UTC Build Time: 2022-06-29 19:09:58
GoVersion: go1.18
Race Enabled: false
TiKV Min Version: v3.0.0-60965b006877ca7234adaced7890d7b029ed1306
Check Table Before Drop: false
Store: unistore
```
comments: I don't think this is a major issue, maybe moderate. The issue is checking column names with `strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(pi.Expr), col.Name.L)` meaning if any other column is a substring of the partitioning column and is unsigned, the function will return true (that the partition column is unsigned) during CREATE/ALTER TABLE.

review_comments: How about writing a log here for `err`?

I have added a log, but I cannot come up with any way to actually trigger it, since the expression has been validated before it comes here. Only idea I had was to have some configuration or sql_mode that would be different between the  first check (using the sessions config/sql_mode) and the default (mock context/sql_mode), but I did not manage to find a way to trigger it :(

I don't know whether it can be reused. If it can, It can be written like this.

```
func (t *TableInfo) IsPartExprUnsigned() bool {
```

This is a bad idea.
`model` should not depend on `expression` package!

Thank you @hawkingrei and @tiancaiamao for your comments, I assume this can be seen as resolved? Meaning the suggested helper function is OK and should not be a member function of TableInfo?
Any other review comments for this PR?
